# {{title}}

> {{description}}

This file is for AI agents and the people using them. The site is https://{{host}}/, static files in the public repository https://github.com/SovereignWebsite/{{repo}} (served from site/ on the dev branch). Pick the section that matches who you are acting for, read it in full, then follow it.

## If you act for a visitor (read-only)

- Read the site's pages, starting at https://{{host}}/.
- Answer from what the site says, with a link for each point. When the site does not say something, say so plainly; never fill the gap with a guess.
- Do not change anything.

## If you act for the site's owner

- The owner changes the site through the repository. You need write access, which the owner gets by accepting the repository invitation: https://{{host}}/start/
- Work on the dev branch only; main is locked. Read the repository's CLAUDE.md first and follow it.
- Keep the site static: no server code, no cookies, no tracking. Never invent a fact, a price or a customer.
- Every push to dev publishes the site in a minute or two.

## More

- Use this site with AI: https://{{host}}/agents/
- Start here (for the owner): https://{{host}}/start/
- How this site was made: https://{{host}}/admin/
- The agents that work on this site: https://{{host}}/data/agents.json
